name: Charleston Harbor
fish: Redfish, spotted seatrout, flounder, black drum
description: Charleston's harbor, creeks, and nearby inlets provide excellent inshore fishing throughout the year.

name: Hilton Head
description: Fish the tidal creeks, sounds, and coastal waters surrounding one of South Carolina's best-known barrier islands.

name: Murrells Inlet
fish: Flounder, redfish, black drum, Spanish mackerel
description: This coastal inlet offers productive fishing from marsh creeks and jetties to nearshore and offshore waters.

name: Myrtle Beach
description: Piers, beaches, and offshore waters give anglers a variety of ways to fish along the Grand Strand.

name: Lake Murray
fish: Striped bass, largemouth bass, crappie, catfish
description: A large Midlands reservoir known for excellent bass and striped bass fishing just outside Columbia.

name: Lake Marion
fish: Catfish, largemouth bass, striped bass, crappie
description: South Carolina's largest lake offers expansive waters, flooded timber, and excellent fishing opportunities.

name: Lake Hartwell
fish: Largemouth bass, spotted bass, striped bass, crappie
description: This large Upstate reservoir provides miles of shoreline and productive fishing throughout the year.

name: Chattooga River
fish: Rainbow trout, brown trout, brook trout
description: A scenic mountain river along the South Carolina border known for cold water and excellent trout fishing.
